updater.disabled.dev: Updates are disabled in a developer working copy. Update it with git.
updater.disabled.unsupported: This copy of ClipSD was not installed from the official package and cannot update itself. Download the new version from the website.
updater.download.title: Downloading version {version}…
updater.error.check: Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again later.
updater.error.checksum: The downloaded file is damaged and was deleted. Your current version keeps working.
updater.error.download: Could not download the update. Your current version keeps working. Try again later.
updater.error.expired: The update information has an invalid date: it is out of date or dated in the future. Check the date and time on this computer.
updater.error.failed: The update to version {version} did not finish. Your current version keeps working. You can try again from the tray menu: “Check for updates”.
updater.error.install: Could not start the installation. Your current version keeps working.
updater.error.no_package: Version {version} has no installation file for this system.
updater.error.no_space: Not enough disk space for the update: {need} MB needed.
updater.error.rollback: The update channel offers a version older than one ClipSD previously detected. The update will not be installed.
updater.error.untrusted: The update information did not pass the signature check, so nothing will be installed.
updater.failed.cannot_detach: The installation could not be started separately from ClipSD (the systemd-run command is not available). Nothing was changed, ClipSD keeps working. You can install the new version manually: download the archive from the website and run install.sh.
updater.failed.text: Version {version} could not be installed. Your current version of ClipSD will continue to work. You can try again or send us an error report.
updater.install.started: Installing version {version}. ClipSD will restart by itself.
updater.manual.text: Version {version} cannot be installed automatically over your current one. Download it from the website.
updater.offer.heading: Version {version} is available
updater.offer.security: This is an urgent update: it fixes a security problem. Please install it as soon as possible.
updater.offer.security_later: If you press “Later”, ClipSD will remind you again the next time it starts and once a day while it runs.
updater.offer.title: ClipSD update
updater.report.copied: The report has been copied to the clipboard.
updater.report.hint: The report contains no user name and no personal folders. Click “Open on GitHub” (you need a GitHub account) or “Email us”: the report text is filled in automatically.
updater.report.send_failed: The report could not be sent. Copy it and send it via the bug report page or by email.
updater.report.title: Update error report
updater.retry.busy: The update is already being installed. Please wait a minute: ClipSD will restart by itself.
updater.wait.dialog: Version {version} will be installed when you close the open ClipSD window (for example, settings).
updater.wait.selector: Version {version} will be installed when the area selection window closes.
updater.wait.text: Version {version} will be installed when you finish typing and close the editor.
updater.wait.unsaved: Version {version} will be installed when you close the editor. Your unsaved annotations will not be lost.
updater.whatsnew.title: What's new in {version}
